name: agent-file-migration
body: The reconciliation of a repo's local `.opencode/agents/**` files with a newer distributed suite. When an agent moves into the distributed set, a repo that already generated a same-named local file now holds a duplicate; `apg init` reports it loudly but never deletes anything, and the user must remove the local copy by hand. The migration is documented in the layout-upgrade guide (`~/.opencode/lib/apg-upgrade.md`), not enforced by deletion. It exists because the distribution boundary can move across releases while a repo's local files persist.
